advance_only_if: macro mixed minus strongest learned/power incumbent fit-only mAP@R >= 0.002
macro mixed minus incumbent fit-only Recall@1 >= 0
decision.failure: reject the fixed mixed objective without weight tuning or outer evaluation

fit_only: two disjoint SHA-ordered class folds; every arm scored as actual signed-int8 codes
objective: 0.5 coverage positive aggregation + 0.5 pooled positive aggregation; unchanged hard negatives, margin, temperature, anchor penalty, schedule, optimizer, and training budget
outer: only after the joint fit-only gate passes; score selected power and power-initialized mixed learner once
prohibitions: no evaluation data before a passing fit-only gate
storage: exact normalized signed-int8 128-D code, 128 bytes per item
